title: Words to read and colour: Madd letters
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: At-Takathur, Al-Qari'ah, madd letters and shaddah
source: Written for quran/y2 lesson 32 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 32. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Madd letters). Then trace and copy.

questions.a: ta'lamuuna: the waw after the dammah is a madd, two counts.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: read nine madd sounds (بَا بُو بِي ...) and colour alif red, waw green, yaa blue. The teacher listens to today's group.
Extend: find a yaa madd in 102:5.
questions.a: ٱلْيَقِينِ: the yaa after the kasrah.
A) buu (long). Dammah + waw: a long 'uu' for two counts.

questions.q: Yaa is a madd letter when the letter before has ...
Think again: Alif stretches 'a'. Which letters do you think stretch 'u' and 'i'?
